results.title: Deutsche Telekom stock faces Huawei fight over tougher 5G rules
results.snippet: Light Reading reported that the European Union is working on an update to its Cybersecurity Act that could make avoiding high-risk vendors such as Huawei mandatory. The report also cited a German draft regulation that would treat all functions of a 5G base station, rather than only selected components, as critical. results.title: German government prepares ban of Chinese network technology - report - Telecompaper
results.snippet: The German Federal Ministry of the Interior is preparing to ban Chinese network technology, Handelsblatt reports. The ministry plans to review the list of critical infrastructure from the Federal Network Agency (Bundesnetzagentur or BNetzA).
